name: Tree-of-Heaven
desc: Tree-of-Heaven (Ailanthus altissima): a plant that turns sunlight into food. Recorded 22 times near the park in GBIF.
about: Ailanthus altissima ( ay-LAN-thəss al-TIH-sim-ə), commonly known as tree of heaven or ailanthus tree, is a deciduous tree in the quassia family. It is native to northeast, central China, and Taiwan.
